description: Source code for cbs_encoder_impl class implementing GSM-7 and UCS2 encoding for cell broadcast messages, including functions for encoding, message segmentation, and handling GSM-7 character mapping.

classes.name: cbs_encoder_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for encoding cell broadcast messages with GSM-7 and UCS2 encodings.

methods.name: encode_cb_data
methods.description: Encodes a message into cell broadcast data based on the data coding scheme, choosing GSM-7 or UCS2 encoding.

methods.name: select_cbs_encoding
methods.description: Selects encoding type (GSM7 or UCS2) based on the data coding scheme byte.

methods.name: fill_cb_data_gsm7
methods.description: Segments and encodes a message into GSM-7 encoding suitable for cell broadcast pages.

methods.name: fill_cb_data_ucs2
methods.description: Segments and encodes a message into UCS2 encoding suitable for cell broadcast pages.

methods.name: encode_gsm7
methods.description: Encodes an ASCII string into GSM-7 encoding, handling extension characters and packing bits.

methods.name: encode_ucs2
methods.description: Encodes a UTF-8 string into UCS2 encoding, supporting only BMP characters.

methods.name: get_nof_gsm7_chars
methods.description: Calculates the number of GSM-7 characters needed to encode a given string, including escape characters.
